title: What It Takes: Oprah Winfrey, Part 1 (3/4)
summaryZh: 歐普拉回憶四歲時的頓悟，並談到她一直想當演員的夢想。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — What It Takes

sentences.text: And so people would, you know, physically boil clothes in a great big iron pot, and she was boiling clothes and poking them down.
sentences.zh: 以前的人真的會用一個很大的鐵鍋煮衣服，她就在那裡煮衣服，一邊把衣服往下壓。

sentences.text: And I was watching her from the back porch, and I was four years old, and I remember thinking, my life won't be like this.
sentences.zh: 我從後門廊看著她，那年我四歲，我記得我當時心想，我的人生不會是這樣。

sentences.text: My life won't be like this.
And it wasn't from a place of arrogance.
It was just a place of knowing that things could be different for me somehow.
sentences.zh: 那只是一種篤定，知道我的人生總會有些不一樣。

sentences.text: I don't know what made me think that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道自己為什麼會那樣想。

sentences.text: Did you ever consider any other career besides talking, broadcasting, acting?
sentences.zh: 除了說話、廣播、演戲之外，你有沒有考慮過別的職業？

sentences.text: I always wanted to be an actress for most of my adolescent and adult life.
sentences.zh: 從青春期到成年，大部分的時間我都一直想當演員。

sentences.text: My father didn't want me to be because his idea of what an actress was was one of these, you know, lewd women in how are you going to take care of your life.
sentences.zh: 我爸不希望我當演員，因為在他的觀念裡，演員就是那種不正經的女人，還說你要怎麼養活自己。

sentences.text: So I always wanted to be an actress and have taken, I think, a roundabout way to get there because I still don't feel fulfilled as an actress.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直想當演員，我覺得自己是繞了一大圈才走到這裡，因為我到現在還是覺得在演戲上沒有得到滿足。

sentences.text: I still feel like, okay, once I'm now, I own my own studio and all this, but I'm thinking, I did all of this just to be an actress.
sentences.zh: 我還是會想，好吧，我現在有自己的製作公司這些的，但我心裡想的是，我做這一切只是為了當演員。

sentences.text: I just want to be able to act.
For a while, I wanted to be a schoolteacher.
sentences.zh: 有一段時間，我想當學校老師。

sentences.text: In the fourth grade, Mrs. Duncan was my greatest inspiration.
sentences.zh: 四年級的時候，Duncan 老師是我最大的啟發。
